game.name: Fifa Street (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: FIFA Street for Xbox 360 pays tribute to street football in cities such as Rio de Janeiro, London, Amsterdam and New York. With Street Control, players can dribble past their opponents in any way they like, both in single and multiplayer. The best clubs in the world are licensed in this title where the World Tour mode offers 16 tournaments and 20 different challenges.
